title:
Abstract interface that helps with customizing the default {@link JobBase#start} behavior used in
{@link Workflow.Batch} and {@link Workflow.MapReduce}.

Example for calling `myCustomStart` instead of `start`:
```py
def startJob(cls, job, options):
  job.myCustomStart(options)
  return job.get().run
```

Example for modifying the `job` object before calling `start`:
```py
def startJob(cls, job, options):
  modified_job = job.withFields({"options": options}).upsert()
  modified_job.start(options)
  return modified_job.get().run
```
name: Workflow.JobHandler
